meaning.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: No adequate baseline for this seasonal cell yet — this source is not being judged, which is not the same as being healthy.
meaning.NORMAL_outside: NORMAL by the detector's verdict for this weekday and hour; the observed value shown here is not inside the expected band.
meaning.NORMAL_unknown: NORMAL by the detector's verdict for this weekday and hour.
meaning.NORMAL_inside: Observed volume is within the expected band for this weekday and hour.
meaning.CANDIDATE: One abnormal interval recorded. Not yet an incident: promotion requires consecutive abnormal intervals.
meaning.OPEN: Confirmed incident — enough consecutive abnormal intervals to rule out a single-bucket artefact.
meaning.RECOVERING: Back inside the expected band, but held open until enough consecutive normal intervals confirm it.
meaning.SUPPRESSED: Detected while the source was in maintenance. Recorded for history, never notified.

meaning.AVAILABLE: Collected in full for both windows.
meaning.TRUNCATED: The result hit the configured value cap, so the contributors below are the top of the list rather than the whole of it. New and disappeared values cannot be determined under a cap — a value can look new simply because it fell below the cap in the other window — so those counts are not reported.
meaning.UNAVAILABLE: Unavailable — this field was not exposed by the QRadar event schema or DSM for the selected interval. It has not been checked, and no conclusion may be drawn from the absence of contributors here.
meaning.FAILED: The query for this dimension did not complete. It has not been checked.

meaning.PARTIAL: Only part of this interval was collected, so its volume is an undercount rather than a measurement. It never enters a baseline or drives a verdict.
meaning.MISSING: This interval was not collected at all. Its absence says nothing about whether the source was sending events.

meaning.OK: MAD was non-zero, so the robust z-score is a meaningful measure of surprise and the verdict rests on it.
meaning.DEGENERATE: MAD was zero — more than half the baseline samples were identical, which is normal for a steady low-volume source. The z-score is therefore an artefact of the floored scale and was not used. The verdict rests on the deterministic expected-bound, ratio and absolute-delta tests instead, which is sound but weaker evidence, and the confidence is capped to reflect that.
meaning.UNAVAILABLE: No robust score could be computed for this verdict.

source.note7d: This chart is the latest 24 hours, the longest window this page can show. The widget covered 7 days; a 7-day window of one-minute buckets is not available here.

explanation.learningSome: Only {count, plural, one {{shown} complete sample} other {{shown} complete samples}} for this weekday and hour so far — not enough to judge this source against. It is not being assessed, which is not the same as being healthy.
explanation.learningNone: No complete samples for this weekday and hour yet. This source is not being assessed, which is not the same as being healthy.
explanation.degenerate: Baseline variability is zero — more than half of the {samples} samples for this weekday and hour were identical, which is normal for a steady low-volume source. The robust z-score is therefore an artefact and is not used; material deviations fall back to the deterministic expected-band test, which is sound but weaker evidence.
explanation.incomplete: The baseline for this weekday and hour is built from {count, plural, one {{shown} sample} other {{shown} samples}} at {completeness} collection completeness, and the backend has not marked it reliable. Verdicts against it are weaker than they appear.
